title: Boston: four decades, two measuring systems
description:
Follow Boston’s recorded crime through two distinct data eras, with a district map and sourced historical context. Data snapshot: July 12, 2026.

Reproduction and source notes: https://github.com/hadi-nayebi/cartography/tree/main/videos/boston-crime-context-2026-01

Counts are not individual risk. The FBI and newer BPD series use different definitions. Modern categories follow the documented offense-description recipe; public sexual-assault records are absent, not zero.

Music: retained Boston Stable Audio Open score.
